name: Rawang Half Marathon 2026 Powered By JomRun®
short_description: A half marathon event in Rawang, Selangor, Malaysia, held on September 13, 2026, with 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distance options.
ai_summary: The Rawang Half Marathon 2026, powered by JomRun, is scheduled for September 13, 2026, at Aeon Mall Rawang in Rawang, Selangor, Malaysia. The event offers three distance options: 21.1km, 10km, and 5km, catering to a range of runners from beginners to those seeking a half marathon challenge. Registration is currently open for participants interested in joining this JomRun-organized race.
pros: Multiple distance options (21.1km, 10km, 5km) suit different runner levels
Convenient venue at Aeon Mall Rawang
Organized by JomRun, an established race organizer

research_highlights: The 2025 edition of this race was held at Aeon Mall Rawang, Selangor, with categories of 5KM, 10KM and 21.1KM — the same format planned for the 2026 edition.
Only the 21.1KM competitive category gets a race bib with an RFID timing chip; the 5KM and 10KM Fun Run categories use a bib without a timing chip, per JomRun's official event listing.
At the 2025 edition, a hospital sponsor (Selgate Specialist Hospital Rawang) provided on-site free health screenings, physiotherapy/sports massage, and standby ambulance support for runners.
Runner discussion on the local running community forum (Threads) flagged the route as including hilly sections in Rawang.
research_watchouts: Multiple participant comments in a Malaysian running-community thread described the Rawang route's hills as mentally tough, with one calling them 'mencabar minda' (challenging to the mind), and even a local resident said they were cursing throughout the route.
For the Fun Run categories (5KM/10KM), race bibs do not include a timing chip, so casual runners won't get an official chip-timed result — only the 21.1KM category is chip-timed.

faqs.question: When is the Rawang Half Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Rawang Half Marathon 2026, powered by JomRun, is scheduled to take place on September 13, 2026. The event will be held in Rawang, Selangor, Malaysia, at the Aeon Mall Rawang venue. Registration for this race is currently open for interested participants.

faqs.question: What distances can I run?
faqs.answer: Participants in the Rawang Half Marathon 2026 can choose from three distance categories: a 21.1km half marathon, a 10km race, and a 5km race. This range of options allows runners of different experience levels and fitness goals to take part in the event.

faqs.question: Where does the race take place?
faqs.answer: The race takes place at Aeon Mall Rawang, located in Rawang, Selangor, Malaysia. This venue serves as the starting point for all three distance categories offered at the Rawang Half Marathon 2026, making it a central hub for participants and event logistics.

faqs.question: Who organizes this event?
faqs.answer: The Rawang Half Marathon 2026 is organized by JomRun, as indicated by the event's official title, 'Powered By JomRun.' JomRun oversees the race logistics, including registration, which is currently open for runners interested in participating in the 21.1km, 10km, or 5km distances.
